        "contents": "create table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  picture text,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  team_id uuid references public.teams(id) on delete set null,\n  phone_number text,\n  personal_email text,\n  date_of_birth date,\n  removed_access timestamptz,\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to automatically update updated_at column\ncreate or replace function public.handle_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_updated_at() is 'Trigger function that automatically updates the updated_at column to the current timestamp on row updates.';\n\n-- Create trigger function to populate public.users on auth.users creation\n-- Extracts Google OAuth data from auth.users.raw_user_meta_data and auth.users.email\ncreate or replace function public.handle_new_auth_user()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_google_email text;\n  v_google_full_name text;\n  v_google_profile_picture text;\n  v_raw_meta_data jsonb;\nbegin\n  v_raw_meta_data := new.raw_user_meta_data;",

        "contents": "comment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to link profiles when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger\nafter update of email on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.email is distinct from new.email)\nexecute function public.link_user_to_profile();\n\ncomment on trigger link_user_to_profile_trigger on auth.users is 'Trigger that automatically links profiles to users when auth.users.email changes. Runs after email update to ensure the change is committed before linking.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA LINKING\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Link existing profiles to users based on current email matches\n-- This handles any existing data that needs to be linked\n-- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\nupdate public.profiles p\nset user_id = u.id\nfrom public.users u\ninner join auth.users au on u.auth_user_id = au.id\nwhere lower(trim(p.work_email)) = lower(trim(au.email))\n  and (p.user_id is null or p.user_id = u.id);\n\ncomment on table public.profiles is 'User profile data with role and team membership. Pre-created by admin, linked to user after OTP verification. Automatically linked when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Initial schema setup\n-- Purpose: Creates complete database schema with tables, triggers, and restrictive RLS policies\n-- Affected tables: users, profiles, teams\n-- Special considerations: All RLS policies are restrictive - admin operations require service_role or application-level checks\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- ENUM TYPES\n-- ============================================================================\n\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TABLES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create users table (custom table, separate from auth.users)\n-- Stores Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking\n-- Linked to auth.users via auth_user_id for authentication checks\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  auth_user_id uuid unique references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  google_email text not null unique,\n  suggested_work_email text,\n  google_profile_picture text,\n  google_full_name text,\n  last_otp_sent_at timestamptz,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\ncomment on table public.users is 'Custom users table storing Google OAuth user data and OTP tracking.         "contents": "-- Users can update their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can update their own user record\" on public.users\nfor update\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- Users can insert their own user record (during signup via trigger)\ncreate policy \"Users can insert their own user record\" on public.users\nfor insert\nto authenticated\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES - PROFILES TABLE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Users can view their own profile\ncreate policy \"Users can view their own profile\" on public.profiles\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  user_id in (\n    select id\n    from public.users\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\n  )\n);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES - REALTIME MESSAGES TABLE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\ncreate policy \"Users can receive broadcasts for their own user record\" on realtime.messages\nfor select\nto authenticated\nusing (\n  topic like 'users:%'\n  and exists (\n    select 1\n    from public.users\n    where auth_user_id = (select auth.uid())\n    and topic = 'users:' || id::text\n  )\n);\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for Supabase Auth hook function\n-- Trigger functions (handle_new_auth_user, validate_czu_email_domain_trigger) are invoked by triggers, not directly, so no EXECUTE grants needed\ngrant execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) to supabase_auth_admin;\ngrant usage on schema public to supabase_auth_admin;\nrevoke execute on function public.before_user_created_hook(jsonb) from anon, authenticated, public;",

        "contents": "-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger to enforce update restrictions on users table\n-- This trigger runs BEFORE the update to prevent field modifications\ndrop trigger if exists users_update_restriction_trigger on public.users;\n\ncreate trigger users_update_restriction_trigger\nbefore update on public.users\nfor each row\nexecute function public.handle_user_update_restriction();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- RLS POLICIES\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Drop the existing permissive update policy\ndrop policy if exists \"Users can update their own user record\" on public.users;\n\n-- Create a new restrictive update policy that only allows updating suggested_work_email\n-- The trigger function will enforce that only suggested_work_email can be changed\ncreate policy \"Users can update only suggested_work_email\" on public.users\nfor update\nto authenticated\nusing ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id )\nwith check ( (select auth.uid()) = auth_user_id );\n\ncomment on policy \"Users can update only suggested_work_email\" on public.users is 'RLS policy that allows authenticated users to update only their own user record. The handle_user_update_restriction() trigger enforces that only suggested_work_email can be modified, and automatically updates last_otp_sent_at.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- GRANTS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Grant execute permissions for the new trigger function\ngrant execute on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() to authenticated;\ngrant execute on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() to anon;",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Restrict user updates to suggested_work_email only\n-- Purpose: Allows users to only update suggested_work_email field, automatically updates last_otp_sent_at\n-- Affected tables: users\n-- Special considerations: Prevents users from modifying any other fields in the users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to restrict updates to suggested_work_email only\n-- Automatically updates last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes\n-- Prevents users from modifying any other fields in the users table\n-- Uses dynamic jsonb approach to automatically protect all columns except allowed ones\ncreate or replace function public.handle_user_update_restriction()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth, pg_catalog\nas $$\ndeclare\n  -- Whitelist: fields that users are allowed to modify\n  v_allowed_fields text[] := array['suggested_work_email'];\n  \n  -- Fields with special handling logic (not reset from OLD)\n  v_special_fields text[] := array['last_otp_sent_at', 'updated_at'];\n  \n  -- JSONB representations of OLD and NEW records\n  v_old_jsonb jsonb;\n  v_new_jsonb jsonb;\n  v_result_jsonb jsonb;\n  \n  -- Column name for iteration\n  v_column_name text;\nbegin\n  -- Convert records to jsonb for dynamic manipulation",

        "contents": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\n-- Users table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth)\n-- Note: Synced via Next.js server actions, not database triggers\ncreate table public.users (\n  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,\n  email text not null,\n  name text,\n  picture text,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null\n);\n\n-- Role enum for profiles (authorization)\ncreate type public.profile_role as enum ('student', 'team_leader', 'coach', 'admin');\n\n-- Profiles table (pre-created by admin, linked to user after verification)\n-- Focus: Authentication and authorization only\ncreate table public.profiles (\n  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),\n  name text not null,\n  user_id uuid unique references public.users(id) on delete set null,  -- linked after OTP verification\n  work_email text unique not null,\n  role public.profile_role not null default 'student',\n  removed_access timestamptz,  -- null = active, set = revoked\n  removed_access_by uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,\n  created_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  updated_at timestamptz default now() not null,\n  constraint valid_czu_domain check (\n    work_email like '%@studenti.czu.cz' or work_email like '%@pef.czu.cz'\n  )\n);\n\n-- Indexes for auth queries\ncreate index profiles_user_id_idx on public.profiles(user_id);\ncreate index profiles_work_email_idx on public.profiles(work_email);\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Entity Relationships\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n┌─────────────────┐       ┌─────────────────┐\n│   auth.users    │       │    profiles     │\n│  (Supabase)     │       │  (Auth only)    │\n├─────────────────┤       ├─────────────────┤\n│ id (uuid)       │◄──┐   │ id (uuid)       │\n│ email (google)  │   │   │ name            │\n│ ...auth fields  │   └───│ user_id (1:1)   │",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "  v_column_name text;\nbegin\n  -- Convert records to jsonb for dynamic manipulation\n  v_old_jsonb := to_jsonb(old);\n  v_new_jsonb := to_jsonb(new);\n  \n  -- Start with OLD values (protected state)\n  v_result_jsonb := v_old_jsonb;\n  \n  -- Allow only whitelisted fields from NEW to override OLD values\n  foreach v_column_name in array v_allowed_fields\n  loop\n    if v_new_jsonb ? v_column_name then\n      v_result_jsonb := jsonb_set(v_result_jsonb, array[v_column_name], v_new_jsonb-&gt;v_column_name);\n    end if;\n  end loop;\n  \n  -- Handle special field: last_otp_sent_at\n  -- Automatically update when suggested_work_email changes\n  if (v_old_jsonb-&gt;&gt;'suggested_work_email') is distinct from (v_new_jsonb-&gt;&gt;'suggested_work_email') then\n    v_result_jsonb := jsonb_set(v_result_jsonb, array['last_otp_sent_at'], to_jsonb(now()));\n  else\n    -- Keep existing last_otp_sent_at if suggested_work_email hasn't changed\n    v_result_jsonb := jsonb_set(v_result_jsonb, array['last_otp_sent_at'], v_old_jsonb-&gt;'last_otp_sent_at');\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Preserve updated_at from NEW (will be set by handle_updated_at() trigger)\n  -- But we include it here to ensure it's not reset\n  if v_new_jsonb ? 'updated_at' then\n    v_result_jsonb := jsonb_set(v_result_jsonb, array['updated_at'], v_new_jsonb-&gt;'updated_at');\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Convert jsonb back to record type using jsonb_populate_record\n  -- This preserves proper type casting for all columns\n  new := jsonb_populate_record(null::public.users, v_result_jsonb);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.handle_user_update_restriction() is 'Trigger function that restricts user updates to suggested_work_email only using a dynamic whitelist approach. Automatically updates last_otp_sent_at when suggested_work_email changes. Dynamically protects all columns except allowed fields, ensuring new columns added in future migrations are automatically protected without requiring function updates.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "- Delegation to business logic services\n- Logging and observability\n\n**Business Logic** (in service layer):\n- Core business rules and validations\n- Domain-specific operations\n- Data transformations and calculations\n- Business workflow orchestration\n- Domain knowledge and expertise\n\n**Example:**\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Application Logic (tRPC Procedure)\nexport const createUserProcedure = protectedProcedure\n  .input(createUserSchema)\n  .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) =&gt; {\n    try {\n      // Application logic: validation, auth, delegation\n      const result = await createUser({\n        userId: ctx.auth.userId,\n        ...input\n      });\n      \n      return { success: true, data: result };\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Application logic: error handling\n      if (error instanceof CustomError) {\n        throw error;\n      }\n      throw new CustomError(\"INTERNAL_ERROR\", \"An unexpected error occurred\");\n    }\n  });\n\n// Business Logic (Service Layer)\nexport const createUser = async (params: CreateUserParams): Promise&lt;User&gt; =&gt; {\n  const { userId, email, name, role } = params;\n  \n  // Business logic: domain rules\n  if (role === 'admin' &amp;&amp; !await hasAdminPrivileges(userId)) {\n    throw new CustomError(\"UNAUTHORIZED\", \"Insufficient privileges for admin role\", 403);\n  }\n  \n  // Business logic: business validations\n  if (await isEmailAlreadyTaken(email)) {\n    throw new CustomError(\"CONFLICT\", \"Email already registered\", 409);\n  }\n  \n  // Business logic: domain operations\n  const user = await userRepo.create({\n    email: email.toLowerCase(),\n    name: name.trim(),\n    role,\n    status: 'pending_verification'\n  });\n  \n  // Business logic: business workflow\n  await sendWelcomeEmail(user);\n  await createDefaultPreferences(user.id);\n  \n  return user;\n};\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### External API Integration\n\n- Isolate external service calls in dedicated modules\n- Implement retry logic with exponential backoff\n- Map provider errors to internal error types\n- Store sensitive data (tokens, keys) securely\n\n## Database &amp; Data Layer\n\n### ORM Best Practices\n\n- Use type-safe ORMs (Drizzle, Prisma, etc.)",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\n\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { validateRedirectUrl } from \"@/lib/utils\";\n\n/**\n * Handles OAuth callback from Google\n * Exchanges the code for a session and redirects appropriately\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams, origin } = new URL(request.url);\n  const code = searchParams.get(\"code\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n  if (code) {\n    const supabase = await createClient();\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n\n    if (!error) {\n      // Check if user has email identity linked\n      // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n      // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n      const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n      // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n      const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n      const redirectTo = validatedNext || (hasEmail ? \"/protected\" : \"/auth/verify-email\");\n\n      redirect(redirectTo);\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to error page if something went wrong\n  redirect(&#96;/auth/error?error=Failed to authenticate with Google&#96;);\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

          {
            "text": "1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 76
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 77
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Client-side: Immediate feedback",
            "lineNumber": 78
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called",
            "lineNumber": 79
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 80
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email",
            "lineNumber": 81
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 82
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user",
            "lineNumber": 83
          },
          {
            "text": "   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)",
            "lineNumber": 84
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Checked on every request via middleware",
            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",
            "lineNumber": 96
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasLinkedProfile(): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Single query using nested select to check for linked profile\n  // Joins users and profiles tables in a single database call\n  const { data: userWithProfile } = await supabase\n    .from(\"users\")\n    .select(\"profiles(id)\")\n    .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.id)\n    .single();\n\n  return !!userWithProfile?.profiles &amp;&amp; userWithProfile.profiles.length &gt; 0;\n}",

        "contents": "const channelRef = useRef(null)\n\nuseEffect(() =&gt; {\n  // Check if already subscribed to prevent multiple subscriptions\n  if (channelRef.current?.state === 'subscribed') return\n  const channel = supabase.channel('room:123:messages', {\n    config: { private: true }\n  })\n  channelRef.current = channel\n\n  // Set auth before subscribing\n  await supabase.realtime.setAuth()\n\n  channel\n    .on('broadcast', { event: 'message_created' }, handleMessage)\n    .on('broadcast', { event: 'user_joined' }, handleUserJoined)\n    .subscribe()\n\n  return () =&gt; {\n    if (channelRef.current) {\n      supabase.removeChannel(channelRef.current)\n      channelRef.current = null\n    }\n  }\n}, [roomId])\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Database Triggers\n\n### Using realtime.broadcast_changes (Recommended for database changes)\nThis would be an example of catch all trigger function that would broadcast to topics starting with the table name and the id of the row.\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION notify_table_changes()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nSECURITY DEFINER\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(\n    TG_TABLE_NAME ||':' || COALESCE(NEW.id, OLD.id)::text,\n    TG_OP,\n    TG_OP,\n    TG_TABLE_NAME,\n    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,\n    NEW,\n    OLD\n  );\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\nBut you can also create more specific trigger functions for specific tables and events so adapt to your use case:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION room_messages_broadcast_trigger()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nSECURITY DEFINER\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM realtime.broadcast_changes(\n    'room:' || COALESCE(NEW.room_id, OLD.room_id)::text,\n    TG_OP,\n    TG_OP,\n    TG_TABLE_NAME,\n    TG_TABLE_SCHEMA,\n    NEW,\n    OLD\n  );\n  RETURN COALESCE(NEW, OLD);\nEND;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nBy default, &#96;realtime.broadcast_changes&#96; requires you to use private channels as we did this to prevent security incidents.\n\n### Using realtime.send (For custom messages)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\nCREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION notify_custom_event()\nRETURNS TRIGGER AS $$\nSECURITY DEFINER\nLANGUAGE plpgsql\nAS $$\nBEGIN\n  PERFORM realtime.send(\n    'room:' || NEW.room_id::text,\n    'status_changed',",

        },
        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @param supabaseClient - Optional Supabase client to use. If not provided, creates a new client.\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(\n  supabaseClient?: Awaited&lt;ReturnType&lt;typeof createClient&gt;&gt;\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = supabaseClient ?? await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 193
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 254
          }
        },
        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Supabase Configuration Changes",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "Update [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth]",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.email]",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.external.google]",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "client_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "secret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "All verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "This approach:",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "The project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "**Useful MCP commands for development:**",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "- Test profile linking and access revocation queries",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "## Key Security Features",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabase (Data Layer Only)",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Database Constraints**:",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **No RLS or Functions**:",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "   - No Row Level Security policies",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "   - No database triggers or functions",
            "lineNumber": 254
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.2887907922267914

        "contents": "create or replace function my_schema.hello_world()\nreturns text\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  return 'hello world';\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Function with Parameters and Fully Qualified Object Names\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function public.calculate_total_price(order_id bigint)\nreturns numeric\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\ndeclare\n  total numeric;\nbegin\n  select sum(price * quantity)\n  into total\n  from public.order_items\n  where order_id = calculate_total_price.order_id;\n\n  return total;\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Function as a Trigger\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function my_schema.update_updated_at()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  -- Update the \"updated_at\" column on row modification\n  new.updated_at := now();\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncreate trigger update_updated_at_trigger\nbefore update on my_schema.my_table\nfor each row\nexecute function my_schema.update_updated_at();\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Function with Error Handling\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function my_schema.safe_divide(numerator numeric, denominator numeric)\nreturns numeric\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nas $$\nbegin\n  if denominator = 0 then\n    raise exception 'Division by zero is not allowed';\n  end if;\n\n  return numerator / denominator;\nend;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Immutable Function for Better Optimization\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sql\ncreate or replace function my_schema.full_name(first_name text, last_name text)\nreturns text\nlanguage sql\nsecurity invoker\nset search_path = ''\nimmutable\nas $$\n  select first_name || ' ' || last_name;\n$$;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./lib/supabase/proxy.ts",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 3
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 125,
            "column": 1
          }
        },
        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Check for email identity verification first if user is authenticated\n  // This check runs for protected routes and pending-approval route\n  // Skip this check only for verify-email route and other auth routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp; !isVerifyEmailRoute &amp;&amp; (!isPublicRoute || isPendingApprovalRoute)) {\n    // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n    const { data: { user: authUser } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n    if (authUser) {\n      const identities = authUser.identities || [];\n      const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\n        (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n      );\n\n      // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n      if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n        return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  if (user &amp;&amp;
